frontier_model: very-general Q(i)-Weil sixfold in discriminant class [-3]
source_theory_baseline: Ordinary derived deformation, Ext obstruction theory and semiregularity/trace maps are admitted source mathematics and receive no Enterprise attribution by themselves.

exact_block.missing_object: A coherent sheaf/complex E (or algebraic family) on the target [-3] component with a nonzero exceptional projection of ch_3(E) to W_K(A_gen)
exact_block.why_necessary: Semiregularity can show that a characteristic class attached to an existing algebraic/derived object remains of algebraic origin under suitable deformations; it does not manufacture the initial object or its exceptional Weil component on a disconnected discriminant component.
exact_block.why_split_source_does_not_supply_it: The known split secant-sheaf source lives in discriminant [-1], and the standard K-compatible deformation/isogeny/Hecke/derived transport routes cannot change the discriminant to [-3].
exact_block.unblock_condition: Construct E directly on the [-3] component, or construct a genuinely new algebraic correspondence producing such E/class there, then compute Ext^1/Ext^2 and the semiregularity channels.

attribution_result.reason: No proof-critical cancellation operation exists before a target-side source object is constructed. Calling the standard semiregularity map itself an Enterprise transform would violate the H0M baseline.
